name: io.github.dev-pratapk/attest-proxy
title: Attest proxy
description: Zero-code proxy: policy, human gate, read-back and a hash-chained ledger for any MCP server.

packageArguments.name: --upstream
packageArguments.description: Command that starts the real MCP server, e.g. "npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-gmail"

packageArguments.name: --server
packageArguments.description: System name for tools without a prefix (gmail, slack, hubspot, …)

packageArguments.name: --mode
packageArguments.description: block (wait for the inbox / Slack), pending (return a resume token), auto (dev)

environmentVariables.name: ATTEST_INBOX_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the confirm inbox (attest serve) linked from Slack cards

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Slack bot token for confirm cards
